spans.s:
स्कु, ii. 5, स्कुनु, and 2, स्कुना, नी, Par. Ātm.
 1. † To go by leaps.
 2. To cover, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 82.
 3. † To lift.
 4. † To approach.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To cover in one's turn, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 82.
 --Cf. Lat. ob-scurus, scutum, corium, cavere, cautus, causa; probably A.S. scuva, umbra; Goth. skôh; A.S. scoh, sceo; O.H.G. scur, tugurium; A.S. scúnian; O.H.G. skiuhan also A.S. scawian, sceawian, to see (concerning the signification, cf. वृ, ὁράω); ἐπι-σκύνιον, σκῦτος.

† स्कुन्द् स्कुन्द्, स्कन्द् स्कन्द्, i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To jump or go by leaps.
 2. To raise (cf. 1. स्कन्द्).
† स्कुम्भ् स्कुम्भ्, ii. 5, स्कुभ्नु, and 9, स्कुभ्ना, नी,

. To stop or hinder.
 2. To hold; cf. स्कम्भ्.
